_auth_and_quota.oauth: Nango (Microsoft Identity / Entra ID), tenant common, scopes 'https://ads.microsoft.com/msads.manage offline_access'; access token ~1h, refresh token 90d sliding with rotation (Nango persists the rotated refresh token)

_derivation.attribute_vs_statistic: kind dimension = attribute column, kind metric = performance statistic, classified in build_official_fields.py from the 'Columns that group the data' guide (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/advertising/guides/reports?view=bingads-13#columnsdata). Quality-score snapshot columns (QualityScore, ExpectedCtr, AdRelevance, LandingPageExperience, QualityImpact) and bid columns are ATTRIBUTES; Historical* quality columns are per-TimePeriod statistics (non-additive). Live confirmation of this classification is a ROLLOUT_NOTES probe item.
_derivation.count_reference: Verified live column counts 2026-07-21: CampaignPerformance 132, AccountPerformance 111, AdGroupPerformance 104, AdPerformance 92, KeywordPerformance 80, GeographicPerformance 80, SearchQueryPerformance 61, AgeGenderAudience 38. Report type inventory: 48 ReportRequest data objects (reporting-data-objects page). Supermetrics header claims 95 metrics + 168 dimensions; it omits official families (App campaigns Installs/CPI/CPP/CPS, NewCustomer*, ConversionDelay, AdStrength, AssetGroup*) so it is never the authority.
_derivation.note: official_fields.json is produced by build_official_fields.py (committed alongside, deterministic, no network). The 8 primary report types are covered INTEGRALLY: every xs:enumeration value of their live learn.microsoft.com XSD value-set pages (fetched 2026-07-21, research dossier microsoft-ads-catalog-research.md section 3) is declared once as a catalog field, deduplicated across report types with a per-report availability list in the description and in field_compatibility selectable_set rules. The 40 remaining v13 report types are declared as excluded report-surface fields (excluded_fields, reason 'report-type-next-tier') -- NEVER planned (Jean's rule: the catalog is complete AT EXECUTION). The public GitHub mirror MicrosoftDocs/Advertising-docs is STALE since 2021 (88 vs 132 campaign columns) -- never use it; always fetch the live pages.

_freshness_and_lookback.conversion_window_days: goals configurable up to 90; conversions credited to the CLICK date (past days re-materialize)

_section_note: Sections mirror the Supermetrics catalog section names (tiering base, dossier section 6) plus two official-only sections Supermetrics omits (APP CAMPAIGNS, NEW CUSTOMER) and REPORT SURFACES (the 40 excluded next-tier report types). Ratio columns (Ctr, AverageCpc, AverageCpm, *Percent, *Rate, ReturnOnAdSpend, CostPer*, RevenuePer*) are cataloged (no silent gap) with a NON-ADDITIVE note and land RAW at day grain when selected via catalog_daily (GSC average_position pattern) -- never summed downstream (AD-4); they are excluded from the pruned tier-core default selection via field_tier_overrides.
_tier_override_note: The core tier is EXACTLY the pruned default-selection surface: 5 additive core metrics (spend/impressions/clicks/conversions/revenue) + the structural id/name/date columns. Ratio metrics (ctr, average_cpc, average_cpm) and non-additive average_position are pinned to standard so the None-selection default of catalog_daily never carries a non-additive or non-numeric-aggregatable column (review google-ads lesson: pruned default selection).

column_restrictions._note: Provider-vocabulary provenance for the field_compatibility rules below (PascalCase column names as documented). The machine-enforced form is the field_compatibility block (core field_compat contract, schema_version 1, field ids); build_official_fields.py regenerates the rules from this provenance + the column enums so the two can never drift.
column_restrictions._restricted_note: Documented per report: Account/AdGroupPerformance restrict {BidMatchType, DeviceOS, Goal, GoalType, TopVsOther}; CampaignPerformance adds {BudgetAssociationStatus, BudgetName, BudgetStatus}. The union is exact in practice because the Budget* columns only exist in the CampaignPerformance enum, and impression-share columns only exist in the Account/AdGroup/Campaign enums.

descriptive_mutable._note: Story 26.6 Part A -- GENERATED by build_official_fields.py (do not edit by hand). Entity STATUS/TYPE attributes that mutate over time for a fixed grain (campaign/ad group/ad/keyword status, campaign/ad group/ad type, account/budget/asset-group status): the connector lands them in attributes_json (latest-wins, HORS partition) instead of segments_json (the QUALIFY supersede grain key), so a refetch re-reading a window with a changed status does NOT double the window's metrics. Grain-bearing ids/names and segmenting dimensions (age/geo/device/network/match type/time) are NEVER listed here.

field_compatibility._note: GENERATED by build_official_fields.py -- do not edit by hand. Core contract (core/field_compat.py, schemas/field-compatibility.schema.json): mutually_exclusive = the Column Restrictions (impression-share statistics vs restricted attributes; audience-share family vs customer attributes); selectable_set x8 (scope {'report_type': ...}) = the INTEGRAL per-report column enums, so an out-of-enum selection is refused pre-call by core.field_compat.enforce_selection with context. The >=1 attribute + >=1 non-impression-share statistic request invariant is not expressible in the typed rule kinds; the connector's request builder enforces it as a typed pre-call InvalidRequestError (rule id 'request-invariants-min-attr-min-stat', tested). _non_additive_statistics (F-2, review 26.4) marks every ratio/average/share/cost-per/historical statistic (AD-4 superset of _impression_share_statistics): the connector refuses report-type inference when several covering types of different grains exist AND one of these is selected.

probe.structural_note: Microsoft Ads reporting is ASYNC: SubmitGenerateReport (POST reporting.api.bingads.microsoft.com/Reporting/v13/GenerateReport/Submit) -> Poll (.../GenerateReport/Poll, status Pending|Success|Error, official guidance 2-15 min interval, ReportRequestId valid 2 days) -> download ZIP CSV from ReportDownloadUrl (URL valid 5 MINUTES: download immediately after the completing poll). A probe batch = one Daily report request over a 1-day window on the selected account with the batch's columns for the field's report type; each request must contain >=1 attribute column and >=1 non-impression-share statistic (add TimePeriod+Impressions as carriers when probing pure attributes). A rejected batch (400 ReportingService* code, e.g. 2015 RequiredColumnsNotSelected) is bisected to isolate the exact offending column. Codes 207 ConcurrentRequestOverLimit and 117 CallRateExceeded pause-and-resume the SAME batch (breaker path); the concurrent-report cap is undocumented so submits are serialized (batch_size kept low).
